(defstruct Big (a i64) (b i64) (c i64) (d i64))
(define g : Big (Big 1 2 3 4))
(define (main) : i64 (read-after (& g)))
(define (read-after [r : (& r Big)]) : i64 (drop-temporary) r.a)
(define (drop-word [n : i64]) : unit (set! g (Big n n n n)))
(defstruct Handle (:cleanup close-handle) (n i64 (:cleanup drop-word)))
(define (fd [h : (& Handle)]) : i64 h.n)
(define (drop-temporary) : unit (fd (& (Handle 9))) unit)
